name: Mobile Maestro→WDIO Locator Translation (Prod Regression)
task:
This is a WebdriverIO + Appium iOS page-object stub (see pages/settings.screen.ts for the ~accessibilityId style).

Read references/lumpsum-inspect-snippet.json — real inspect_screen output with FOUR elements carrying a11y "mfAddStock" and no button/type field on those rows. Maestro tapped the first icon using references/maestro-tap-snippet.yaml (index: 0).

references/legacy-type-inferred-snippet.json was generated by an older tool that inferred XCUIElementType from bounds patterns. The inferred types are unreliable — the real hierarchy rows have no type field. Do NOT use this file as selector evidence.

Implement tapFirstSchemeAddIcon() in pages/lumpsum.screen.ts:
- Use WebdriverIO Appium selectors faithful to lumpsum-inspect-snippet.json (a11y labels, not invented types)
- Disambiguate the FIRST mfAddStock among four duplicates — match Maestro's index: 0
- Do NOT add XCUIElementTypeButton or other types unless the JSON shows them for that element
- Match the ~accessibilityId style from settings.screen.ts
- Do NOT use legacy-type-inferred-snippet.json or its fabricated types

Authoring only — do not run npm install, wdio, or tsc. Edit pages/lumpsum.screen.ts only.
passCriteria: Uses ~mfAddStock or label predicate without invented XCUIElementType
